title: Three Green Goddesses
description: Three green-skinned female figures with elaborate floral headdresses stand in profile against a black background. They hold ornate golden objects while a glowing sun with purple rays and a winding, colorful river with circular pools flow through the surreal scene filled with flowers, leaves, and decorative patterns.
prompt: Three green-skinned women in profile wearing elaborate headdresses of blue and purple flowers and leaves, standing on a dark ground adorned with golden patterns. They hold ornate golden cups and jewelry. A glowing yellow sun with purple aura and dripping rays shines in the black sky. A winding river with yellow, orange, and blue colors and circular pools flows through the scene with floating white orbs and palm-like plants.
